items.exampleEn: The color of the car is unimportant to me.
items.exampleZh: 車子的顏色對我來說不重要。

items.exampleEn: My English is worse than my sister's.
In Japan, cars drive on the left-hand side.
items.exampleZh: 在日本，車子是靠左邊行駛的。

items.exampleEn: The bathroom is the second door on the right-hand side.
items.exampleZh: 廁所是右手邊的第二扇門。

items.exampleEn: This is a well-known song in Taiwan.
items.exampleZh: 這是一首在台灣家喻戶曉的歌。

items.sentenceEn: The bank is on the left-hand side of the street.

items.audioEn: The traffic today is worse than yesterday.
items.audioZh: 今天的交通比昨天還糟。

items.sentenceZh: 不要為不重要的事擔心。

items.sentenceEn: Write your name in the right-hand corner.
items.sentenceZh: 把你的名字寫在右邊的角落。

items.stemEn: This singer is ____ in Asia. Everyone knows her.
items.stemZh: 這位歌手在亞洲很有名，大家都認識她。

items.stemEn: It was the ____ day of my life. Everything went wrong.
items.stemZh: 那是我人生中最糟的一天，每件事都出錯。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, we drove to a well-known beach. The traffic was terrible, and it got worse after lunch. My dad said, "This is the worst trip ever!" When we finally arrived, the view was marvelous. We parked on the left-hand side of the road, and there was a small cafe on the right-hand side. My mom said the traffic was unimportant now. "Look at the sea!"
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們開車去一個有名的海灘。路上塞車很嚴重，午餐後更糟了。爸爸說：「這是史上最糟的旅行！」好不容易到了之後，風景美極了。我們把車停在路的左側，右側有一家小咖啡店。媽媽說，塞車現在一點也不重要了：「看看海吧！」

questions.questionZh: 午餐後交通變得怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 這是我看過最糟的電影。
referenceEn: This is the worst movie I have ever seen.
It's the worst movie I've ever seen.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 the worst … I have ever seen

items.instructionZh: 用 well-known 造一個句子，介紹一個有名的人、地方或東西。
referenceEn: This restaurant is well-known for its seafood.
My aunt is a well-known cook in our town.
rubricZh: well-known 表示「有名的」（例如 a well-known cook、well-known for…）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 My aunt is）
